tips.title: Season 4 - Day 1
tips.content:
T minus 12 hours until Season 4 starts!

As always, please message me or ask in world chat for any clarification

►Prep◄
• Claim rewards from Season Preview (S4 Icon)
• Consider last minute items from Season Store
• SAVE Doom Walker kill and about 20 radar tasks until after the map changes: 
• Immediately before the map changes, you can send trucks to avoid being plundered

► Immediately after map change follow these steps ◄
1. Donate: Season: IV ► Season IV ► Week 1
2. Paying players: Buy planned Season/Weekly Passes
3. Use all Hero's Return Tickets
4. Rest/Allocate Profession skills with this priority:
    a. Season Resources
    b. Building costs
    c. Professional XP
    d. Building Time
    - Even level 100 pros need XP for Tactics Cards
    - Use Skill Book or Profession Change if needed
    - Almost everyone should be Engineers
5. Kill highest Oni Legion (Doom Walker) your alliance is able (collect rewards)
6. Build/Upgrade Quartz Workshop 1 (and extra if you have weekly pass)
7. Repair Lighthouse at front of your base (near armored truck) and one generator
8. Kill zombies up to level 3
9. Activate Generator
10. Turn Lighthouse to L1

► Initial Strategy ◄
• Upgrade Quartz Workshops evenly and as quickly as possible. Workshops 2-4 unlock when the previous hits 15.
• Capture Strongholds as quickly as possible. Message me for help clearing them.
• Pack hives tightly around alliance center, position active players so their light covers as much of the hive as possible. Others send electricians to help
• Buy special items from Magatama Shop ASAP

Daily:
• Kill highest Oni Legion you can
• Virus leaders assist advancing Night Wolves (Doom Elite) level for all members.
   - Those being assisted, use one hero squads
• Complete Izakaya Bar radar task (even on non-radar VS days)

ALSO: I'm still waiting to hear from all R4s and R5s out there so that we can coordinate!
